title: 第13章 唐凝后悔结婚吗第14章 未来孩子的父亲
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第13章唐凝，后悔结婚吗？纪瑾修幽深的眸子停滞在她疑惑的脸上。
半晌，他扯开薄唇，“是一对……”
后面的话被突兀的手机铃声吞噬。
唐凝没听见。
窗外，华灯升起。
“接个电话，你先休息。”纪瑾修深邃的眼底悄然浮起异色，声音依旧温和。
唐凝嗯了声。
纪瑾修在病房走廊远处，划听来电：“说。”
脸上的温和消失殆尽，取而代之的是冰冷凛冽的神色。
陈特助气愤：“纪总，调取了餐厅监控，朱厌那么对太太，腿断了都算轻的。”
纪瑾修拿下手机，点开视频，冰冷的面容瞬间如暴风雨来临前的阴郁。
“朱家不会管教儿子，我会替他教。”
纪瑾修掐了通话，手机揣回兜里，目光忽然落在左手腕表上。
黑色盘面上是璀璨浩瀚的星辰，跟唐凝的那款是一对。
纪瑾修嘴角弧度不自觉扬起，眼底凛冽的寒意瞬间被温柔的笑意掩盖。
五年前，他没能送出的礼物，兜兜转转，达成所愿。
……
唐凝被纪瑾修陪护了一整夜。
吃了点东西，一觉睡到早晨，被林蔓电话吵醒。
“凝凝，我给你发了那么多消息，怎么不理我？”

“就因为我给你发了小视频，给你送了那种新婚礼物，你生气了？”
病房内太过寂静，林蔓的声音在话筒里也显得格外清晰。
唐凝注意到沙发上的纪瑾修，脸一热，连忙清了清嗓子：“我昨晚睡得有点早，没你想的那样。”
林蔓松口气，对她住院的事一无所知。
她人在国外，唐凝不想让她担心，索性不告诉她。
她又不怀好意地笑问：“那我送你的新婚礼物，还喜欢吗？”
新婚礼物？
唐凝想起来了，之前回房子那边收拾东西，物业把代收的快递给她，她带回了别墅，快递一直放在箱子里，忘了拆。
她可不能实话实说，尴尬笑了两声：“喜欢啊，还不错。”
林蔓惊讶：“可以嘛，凝凝，结个婚你都开窍了。”
唐凝莫名其妙皱了眉。
两人又聊了会，才挂了电话。
唐凝点开林蔓的聊天框。
聊天页面发了好几个小视频。
林蔓：“姐妹，好东西哦，快看，不谢。”
唐凝随后点开一个视频，页面加载呈现腹肌男，有声和谐片……
content_en:
Chapter 13 Tang Ning, do you regret getting married? Ji Jinxiu's deep eyes stopped on her puzzled face.
After a while, he opened his thin lips and said, "It's a pair..."
The next words were swallowed up by the sudden ringtone of the cell phone.
Tang Ning didn't hear it.
Outside the window, the lights rose.
"Answer the call, you should rest first." Ji Jinxiu's deep eyes suddenly revealed a strange color, but his voice remained gentle.
Tang Ning hummed.
Ji Jinxiu was far away in the corridor of the ward, listening to the call: "Say."
The gentleness on his face disappeared, replaced by a cold and stern expression.
Chen Teshu was angry: "Mr. Ji, we called in the restaurant surveillance. Zhu Yan treated his wife like that. Even if his leg is broken, it's not a big deal."
Ji Jinxiu took off his phone and clicked on the video. His cold face instantly resembled the gloom before the storm.
"The Zhu family doesn't know how to discipline their son, I will teach him for him."
Ji Jinxiu dialed the call, put his phone back in his pocket, and his eyes suddenly fell on the watch on his left hand.
There are bright and vast stars on the black disk, which is the same pair as Tang Ning's.
The corners of Ji Jinxiu's mouth raised unconsciously, and the coldness in his eyes was instantly covered up by a gentle smile.
The gift he failed to give five years ago has finally come true.
…
Tang Ning was accompanied by Ji Jinxiu all night.
After eating something, I slept until morning, when I was woken up by Lin Man's phone call.
"Ning Ning, I've sent you so many messages, why are you ignoring me?"
"Are you angry just because I sent you a short video and gave you that kind of wedding gift?"
It was too quiet in the ward, and Lin Man's voice sounded particularly clear on the microphone.
Tang Ning noticed Ji Jinxiu on the sofa, her face heated up, and she quickly cleared her throat: "I went to bed a little early last night, not as much as you thought."
Lin Man breathed a sigh of relief, knowing nothing about her hospitalization.
She was abroad, and Tang Ning didn't want her to worry, so she simply didn't tell her.
She smiled maliciously and asked, "Then, do you still like the wedding gift I gave you?"
Wedding gift?
Tang Ning remembered that when she went back to the house to pack her things, the property manager gave her the courier for collection, and she took it back to the villa. The courier was kept in the box and she forgot to open it.
She couldn't tell the truth, so she laughed twice awkwardly: "I like it, it's not bad."
Lin Man was surprised: "Okay, Ning Ning, you will be enlightened after getting married."
Tang Ning frowned inexplicably.
The two chatted for a while before hanging up the phone.
Tang Ning clicked on Lin Man's chat box.
Several short videos were posted on the chat page.
Lin Man: "Sister, it's a good thing. Take a look. You're welcome."
Tang Ning then clicked on a video, and the page loaded showing a man with abdominal muscles, a video with audio...
